text: Now I want to remind you that you are not the customer of the platform, you are the product because your eyeballs are then sold to advertisers. And so these platforms know that if they can get you to stay on the platform longer, that makes you a more valuable sell to the real customer. This should make you angry that your eyeballs are exploited with anger and rage bait and rage bait. You perhaps have seen this happen before. You wake up in the morning and you see a video on social media and it pulls anger to the surface.
